name: F2 Feeder Career 2026
author: community
description: Two Driver Careers that start in Formula 2: F2 2025 then F1 2026, and F2 2026 then F1 2027. Each has its own tile and save slots; the stock 2026 career is unchanged.

saves.message: F2 Feeder careers won't load without it; the launcher keeps them in the save until it is back on.
